title: saussurea japonica var. intermedia
intro: Saussurea japonica var. intermedia, commonly known as Japanese costus root or Japanese saussurea, is a plant species used in traditional medicine, particularly in East Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis, digestive issues, and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Saussurea japonica var. intermedia include modulating immune responses, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting cytotoxic effects against cancer cells. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
